Method of Attack: Path traversal vulnerability exploited to write or plant arbitrary files on systems running vulnerable versions of Zoom.
Exploitation of GIFs from third-party attacker-controlled servers to achieve directory traversal and save malicious files disguised as GIFs.
Exploitation of Zoom's zip file extraction feature to plant arbitrary binaries on targeted computers.
Attack Vector: Sending specially crafted messages through the chat feature to an individual or a group.
Embedding GIFs from third-party attacker-controlled servers.
Sharing code snippets via Zoom's chat functionality with a specially crafted zip file.
